tooltips.isCorporate: Enable for legal entities. Corporate customers can be issued a VAT invoice (rēķins) and use corporate pricing.
tooltips.hasContract: This customer works under a contract — orders are invoiced, so they are marked Paid on creation. Independent of 'Corporate': there are contracts with private individuals.
tooltips.allowWhatsapp: The customer consented to receive offers via WhatsApp. Without it, a mailing on this channel does not reach them.
tooltips.allowEmail: The customer consented to receive offers via email.
tooltips.allowPhone: The customer consented to receive offers by phone (calls / SMS).
tooltips.vehiclePlates: The customer's plate numbers (newest first). Filled automatically from the vehicle list.
tooltips.driverNames: The customer's drivers (newest first). Filled automatically from the driver list.
tooltips.allowServiceMessages: Messages about the customer's own order: car ready, booking confirmation and reminder. On by default; the customer turns it off with the link in every message or by replying STOP. Independent of marketing consent.
tooltips.serviceMessagesOffAt: When the customer opted out of service messages.
tooltips.language: Language of messages to this customer. Empty = the system language.
tooltips.notifyChannel: Automatic picks the first channel that is enabled, configured and has a contact for this customer (order: Administration, Notifications).
tooltips.telegramChatId: Filled when the customer opens the bot link and presses Start.
